market_outlook.short_term: Risk-off environment dominates. Oil near $100 and US-Iran strikes create volatility. Dow futures down 300 points. Yen rally adds FX stress. Trade war with Canada broadens. Expect elevated VIX and sector rotation into energy, defense, and gold. Retail weakness and consumer pressure cap upside. 1-3 month: choppy, range-bound with upside capped by inflation fears.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month: AI infrastructure capex cycle remains intact but faces 'wall of reality' in South Korea. Defense spending structurally elevated. Yen strength may persist if BOJ maintains hawkish stance. Oil premium may normalize if Hormuz de-escalates. Retail structural decline continues. Social Security solvency debate may force fiscal policy shifts. S&P 500 rebalancing (Illumina, Everpure additions) provides modest index support.
